 -versus-

.Party
 Mr. S.S.Mohapatra, Asc
 Coram:
 Justice M.S.Sahoo
 Order
15.11.2023 Order No. Hybrid Mode 05

. 1 . The BLAPL praying for grant of bail has been filed under Section 439, Cr.P.C, seeking release of the petitioner, who is in jail custody in connection with Gochhapada P.S. Case No.66 of 2023 corresponding to C.T. Case No.41 of 2023 pending in the court of learned Addl. District & Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge under POCSO Act for alleged commission of offence under Sections 363/366/376(2)(n)/376(3) of I.P.C. r/w Section 6(1) of POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is in custody since 13.07.2023.
It is further submitted that the petitioner should be shown indulgence as far as prayer for bail is considering his age.

// 2 //
3. Learned ASC opposes the prayer of the petitioner for grant of bail referring to the materials contained in the case diary produced by the investigating agency.
4. Learned counsel appearing for the informant/victim apart from opposing prayer for bail, submits that there is threat to the victim/informant and her family.
5. This Court has occasion to go through the case diary and the statement of the victim recorded under section 164 of Cr.P.C. by the learned J.M.F.C., Phulbani.

6. Having heard learned counsel for the petitioner, the submissions of the learned counsel for the State and the learned counsel of the informant/victim, this Court is inclined to grant bail to the petitioners on such stringent terms and conditions that would be imposed by the learned court in seisin of the matter which shall also include a condition that any deviation from/violation of any of the terms and conditions that would be imposed for grant of bail shall result in filing of petition for cancellation of bail by the investigating agency/informant/victim.
The BLAPL is disposed of accordingly.

Though the petition stands disposed of, since learned counsel for informant/victim has submitted regarding threat perception and her family, SDPO concerned shall do the needful to ensure that the // 3 // informant/victim and her family are given adequate protection as would be if necessary.
Before providing such protection, the SDPO shall do well to make local enquiry and ascertain the threat perception, if any, as stated.
Free copy of the order be handed over to the learned ASC.
Issue urgent certified copy as per rules.
Copy of the order shall be uploaded.
(M.S.Sahoo) Judge dutta Sumanta Digal vs State Of Odisha ....
